hero.description: At DIMTECH, our students are our greatest assets. That’s why we carefully select candidates who have the potential to thrive and excel in our program.

requirements.title: Educational Qualification
requirements.description: Successfully completed Graduation (a Bachelor's Degree) from a recognized university.

requirements.title: Accepted Streams
requirements.description: Open to graduates from any stream (Arts, Commerce, Science, Engineering, BBA, BCA, etc.).

requirements.title: Document Requirements
requirements.description: General documents are required, such as a Graduation marksheet, [Aadhaar Redacted], and Passport-size photo.

requirements.title: Minimum Marks
requirements.description: 10+2 in any stream with 50% marks (5% relaxation for SC/ST candidates).

requirements.title: No Entrance
requirements.description: No Entrance Exam Needed. We conduct our DIMTECH Aptitude Test (DMAT) for admissions.
